Car autoplay
When your car\'s Bluetooth connects, Melarka shuffles your favorites, even in the background. If music is already playing, nothing changes. Android asks you once to confirm the car.
Choose your car
To list the cars paired with this phone, Melarka needs the Nearby devices permission.
On this Android version, Melarka notices the car only while it is allowed to run in the background. If autoplay doesn\'t start, set Melarka\'s battery usage to Unrestricted.
If autoplay doesn\'t start or music stops with the screen off, set Melarka\'s battery usage to Unrestricted: Settings › Apps › Melarka › Battery.
On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones, also turn on Autostart for Melarka (Settings › Apps › Manage apps › Melarka) and set its Battery saver to No restrictions.
On Huawei and Honor phones, open Settings › Battery › App launch, set Melarka to Manage manually and turn on all three switches.
On OPPO, realme and OnePlus phones, allow Melarka to auto-launch and allow its background activity (Settings › Apps › Melarka › Battery).
On vivo and iQOO phones, allow Autostart for Melarka and allow its high background power consumption (Settings › Battery).
On Samsung phones, add Melarka to Never sleeping apps: Settings › Battery › Background usage limits.
